notes: Irregular 르 verb: before -아/어, 르 changes to 라 and adds ㄹ (자르다 → 잘라요, 잘랐어요).
Also used in 머리를 자르다 ('to get a haircut'). In the sense 'to fire someone', it is informal; the formal term is 해고하다.
